Using the movie data in the opened Excel file, create a new sheet named 'best_2000s' that includes the top 10 highest-rated movies released between 2000 and 2009. Keep the same column structure and sort them by ratings in descending order.

llm_judge_fix_suggestions: To strictly verify 'top 10 highest-rated', consider: (1) load original movies.xlsx, (2) filter to 2000-2009, (3) sort by rating descending, (4) get top 10, (5) compare against result sheet. This would ensure the exact top 10 are present, not just any 10 movies meeting a threshold
Alternative: if rating_min=8.4 is known to be the 10th highest rating in the dataset for 2000-2009, document this assumption in the metric function docstring for clarity
